extracted.name: Whisky mac
extracted.description: Welcome in the weekend with a simple cocktail using the spiky heat of ginger wine paired with scotch. Serve on the rocks
ingredient_lines: strip of pared lemon zest, to serve
instruction_lines: Put a few ice cubes in a rocks glass, then pour over the ginger wine and scotch. Stir gently to combine, then serve with a strip of freshly pared lemon zest.
